title: Acme Fit: store listing
subtitle: The 3.0 listing on Google Play and the App Store, in English and Spanish, for watch, phone and tablet.

sections.title: Brief
sections.lead: Acme Fit 3.0 leads with the week view: one glance shows steps, workouts and the streak.

blocks.md: Runners and riders who track a week, not a day. Every first shot carries one benefit in a few words; the Spanish strings came from machine translation and wait for review.
